shared_elements: schematic rendering of the human face/head
figures shown one above another (stacked/registered composition)
justification: Both depict human figures rendered schematically and both stack figures vertically (a crouching figure beneath an upper head/block in A; superimposed registers of standing figures in B), which is about as generic a correspondence as one can get. The depicted content otherwise diverges completely: A is a volumetric single crouching being with large hollowed eyes, gaping mouth and hands drawn to the body, while B shows flat silhouetted cloaked figures with raised arms and a horse/rider arranged inside a ruled frame with an interlace border, none of which appears in A.
